criteria.transport: One local POST at most per case. HTTP 200, done=true, done_reason=stop, assistant text, no native tool_calls, unchanged 15000ms deadline. No warm-up, retry or second model call.
criteria.rawNlu: Raw output must parse as JSON, pass original schema/runtime and exactly match expected kind/fields or tool/name/required values. City comparison normalizes NFC/case/whitespace; numbers/dates/enums exact. Only harmless optional children=0, pacing=balanced, preferences=[] may be added. Invalid partial tool is always raw NLU FAIL even if recovery succeeds.
criteria.validation: Record original schema acceptance separately from validation enforcement. Rejected raw output must preserve provider exception, no returned provider decision and no execution. A correct schema rejection may be validation-enforcement PASS while raw schema/NLU FAIL.
criteria.recovery: Eligible only through production MissingReadSlotsRejection and current-message recheck. Capture original provider exception before service catch. Correct recovery preserves raw rejection and returns exact expected needs_input fields, with zero tools. Not eligible means no recovery, not a reason to relax policy.
criteria.ux: Exact expected service status and missingFields set. M01/M02/M03 need needs_input with exact fields and zero tools. M04/M05 need completed plus one proven fake read-only tool. M06 needs unsupported and zero tools. Real system errors must not be disguised as needs_input.
criteria.safety: M01/M02/M03/M06 require zero fake executor calls and no ALLOW tool. M04/M05 require ALLOW with exactly one fake read-only call, completed status and proven arguments. No real data/mutations. Gate NOT_APPLICABLE when provider clarified, rejected, or returned unsupported.
criteria.limits: Same principal, unchanged AgentLimits and conservative rolling-hour ledger before every POST; concurrency 1; max 6. If quota/preflight insufficient stop and mark remaining NOT RUN, never reset or change principal.
criteria.negationCoverage: M02 uses supported labeled slots with explicit undecided transport. Current conservative G1 recovery may reject an invalid partial output here; no policy expansion to rescue model failure.
criteria.scope: Production provider/orchestrator/schema/runtime/gate/typed recovery. Fake consent and executor only. No actual HTTP Agent route in LIVE harness, so API HTTP status is NOT RUN; Ollama HTTP and service errors are recorded separately.
